guardian_notice_title: Sanarwa ga Iyaye da Masu Kulawa
guardian_notice_p1:
Wannan manhaja tana da wasannin rarrabawa da gane abubuwa
ga yara masu shekaru 2–3.
guardian_notice_p2:
Da fatan a kasance tare da yaro
ana kula da shi yayin amfani da manhajar.
guardian_notice_p3:
Don taimaka wa yaro ya girma cikin lafiya,
a guji yawan kallon allo, a kuma tsara tsawon lokaci
da yawan lokutan amfani da manhajar yadda ya dace.
guardian_notice_guide: Ba a yi wannan manhaja don tantance matsalolin ilimi ko gano cuta ko bayar da magani ba.
guardian_notice_setting_2: za a iya kashe ta a kowane lokaci a Saituna.
